verdict.rationale: GitHub runs a first-party Marketplace (github.com/marketplace?type=apps) described as apps 'from the community and partners' that integrate with GitHub. It lists concrete third-party integrations such as Render, Atlassian/Jira, Slack, Shopify and a mobile CI service, and GitHub promotes extending your stack with apps, actions and AI models. Missing for 10: documentation of the actual install/authorization flow for marketplace apps, and independent or hands-on corroboration of installing them.
